description: Assign a phone number already in the KaiCalls registry pool to a business (and optionally route it directly to an agent). Does NOT purchase a new number; search_available_numbers and buy_number handle purchases.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to route this number to directly (optional).

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

phone_number.description: E.164 phone number already in the registry.

name: attach_number
title: Attach Phone Number
